a plan (its name only) or self-pay
for a video visit: which state the client will be in
after_time: anything the practice should know to help, like needing an interpreter
the client's name and mobile (for texts)

intake_questions.never_asked: symptoms, pregnancy weeks, tests, results or the birth plan are never asked or typed in the AI chat
intake_questions.who_may_book: the client, or a support person the client names on the secure page; a minor books her own care only where the owner's state form lets her consent alone, and until the form says so a parent or guardian books; a child under 13 never books, and nothing about them is kept
intake_questions.who_may_bring: the client, or a support person the client names with a signed OK on the secure page; the practice may ask for a support person at a first visit, or where the state's rules require one

stop.words: heavy bleeding, a seizure, a bad headache with blurred vision, trouble breathing, chest pain, a fall or a car crash, or a newborn who isn't breathing
stop.say: Call 911 now. Rosie can't book care for an emergency. Then call the practice's on-call line: (555) 010-0188.
stop.booking: no booking; any visit stays booked

stop.words: labor, your water breaking, or less baby movement
stop.say: Call the on-call midwife now: (555) 010-0188. If you can't reach her, or it's an emergency, call 911.
stop.booking: no booking; the on-call midwife answers at any hour, and Rosie books or moves nothing for it

stop.words: thoughts of harming yourself or the baby, or a crisis after the birth
stop.say: Call or text 988 now. If you are in danger, call 911. Your midwife is told.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words in a later text get 988 again

stop.say: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222. If the person isn't breathing or won't wake up, call 911.

go_on.words: a worry with nothing on the lists above
go_on.where: matched to the practice's own visit: Rosie never judges how serious it is

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: Health history, risk screen, the consents and the care agreement
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due before the first visit; one reminder before it's due
steps.result: not done by its due date: the practice keeps the visit (signed on the secure page at the desk first), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand
steps.who: every client who names a plan
steps.result: covered, some services only, not covered, or can't check now (the desk checks later, and the client may cancel free)

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay clients
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day, or sooner where the rules require it
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date

steps.name: A client's records from the last care provider
steps.when: asked for on the secure page; the practice gets them, office to office
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk; the first visit goes ahead without them

steps.name: The owner's OK for a new client
steps.when: before the first visit is booked
steps.result: OK: booked; no: told kindly, nothing kept

first_steps_and_forms.prep: arrive 10 minutes early; bring the plan card, and the records you have from before; a support person comes only with the client's signed OK on the secure page; at home: a clear space for the midwife's supplies

staff.skills: midwives: prenatal visits, the birth at the birth center or at home (where the state's rules allow), postpartum and newborn visits, and well-person visits (nurse-midwives); birth assistants: births and postpartum visits with a midwife; the lactation consultant: breastfeeding help; only people the owner clears go to homes
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each midwife's and birth assistant's own license or certificate, per state, if the owner adds it (optional; never checked by Rosie)
staff.supervision: a midwife who isn't yet fully licensed works under the state's rules for supervision or a collaboration agreement (the owner's form sets it)
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs a new client's first visit, and any visit a midwife flags
staff.stand_in: a midwife out: the backup midwife the client has met may take the visit, with the client's yes; nobody is moved without it

children_and_age.who_may_book: the client, or a support person the client names on the secure page; a minor books her own care only where the owner's state form lets her consent alone, and until the form says so a parent or guardian books; a child under 13 never books, and nothing about them is kept
children_and_age.minors_texts: texts go to the client, or to the person the client names on the secure page; nothing about a newborn is texted to anyone but the parent or guardian
children_and_age.minors_rules: who may consent for a minor, from the state's form (the owner's setting)

visit.check_in: at the birth center: the check-in code at the front desk, and the desk checks the client is the one who booked; a video visit: the code read out at the start; at home: the code from the client at the door
visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the visit notes, results and records stay in the practice's own chart, never in Rosie or a text; the next visit is booked at checkout
visit.changes_at_visit: the midwife decides any test or shot from the client's record; a test is added only with the client's yes, with any self-pay price first; more care is booked as its own visit only if the client asks
visit.before_work: the midwife checks the blood pressure, weight and the changes since the last visit, before the exam

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: optional, and never verified by Rosie: a midwife, a birth assistant or the practice may add a license, certificate or registration it holds; Rosie looks nothing up and never says anything is checked
license.who: the business says what it holds; the owner adds each person's own number on the secure page
license.ask: each person's license or certificate number, if they hold one, in their invite reply (or the owner sends it); the practice's registration number, if it has one
license.insurance: malpractice insurance, if the owner adds it: a note only, never checked

never_in_a_text: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the pregnancy, symptoms, tests, results, the birth or the midwife's name at the birth center (at a home visit the midwife's name stays, for the door check)
languages: English and Spanish; the secure page asks if the client needs an interpreter, and the practice is told
